context.control_limits_en: 1900–1910: French conquest from 1900; north (Borkou, Ennedi, Tibesti) not occupied until 1910s [VERIFY]. | 1910–1960: Northern limit by Anglo-French 1899 declaration and 1919 convention (tripoint 19°30'N 24°E); Tibesti transferred from Niger to Chad 18 Mar 1931; Franco-Italian accord of 7 Jan 1935 moving the line south never ratified. Chad–Sudan line per 1924 exchange of notes. | 1960–2026: Independence 1960 (OHM 2801984 start 1960-08-11). Libya occupied the Aouzou Strip from 1973; ICJ judgment of 3 Feb 1994 upheld the 1955 Franco-Libyan treaty line (Aouzou to Chad); Libyan withdrawal verified by UNASOG (S/RES/915).
